name: deep-search
author: octos
description: Deep multi-round web research: free sources first (GDELT, Google News RSS, optional SearXNG, then keyed APIs), polite page reading (honest User-Agent, per-host spacing, browser for JS-heavy pages; robots.txt optional, off by default), reference chasing, a cited report and structured items.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Deep multi-round web research implemented in Rust, with sandboxed OctoScript metasearch engines. Use for deep research, comprehensive analysis, comparative investigations, 深度研究 and 深入调研. Searches multiple angles, reads sources in parallel, follows references and writes a cited report plus structured items. No run_pipeline, DOT or graph IR is required. Use depth=2 by default, depth=1 for quick bounded research, depth=3 for thorough coverage. Use deep_crawl separately for a specific documentation site or rendered pages. Keep failed reads and gaps explicit; a search snippet alone is not verified source evidence. The host supplies the synthesis model and credentials; do not invent synthesis_config. Controls include lang, query_by_lang, region, since, category, max_per_domain, domains_allow/deny and render. output=report returns the report, output=items returns structured sources; both save the report and items files.

query.description: The research topic or question to investigate

depth.description: Research depth: 1=quick (single search + crawl, ~1min), 2=standard (3 search rounds + reference chasing, ~3min), 3=thorough (5 search rounds + aggressive link chasing, ~5min). Default: 2

max_results.description: Number of search results per round (1-10, default: 8)

search_engine.description: Try one provider first: gdelt, google_news_rss, searxng, serper, tavily, perplexity, brave, you; or all. Default: automatic order (free sources first: GDELT + Google News for news, then SearXNG if configured, then keyed APIs). Results-page search (duckduckgo, bing_cdp) runs last for general web results unless the operator turned it off. Falls back to the automatic order if it returns nothing.

output.description: report (default): Markdown report. items: structured JSON items (url, title, source, lang, published, summary, citation) instead; the report and <slug>_report.items.json are written either way.

lang.description: BCP-47 language(s) to search in and keep, e.g. "en" or ["en", "zh-CN", "es"]. Each language gets its own queries. Unknown-language results are kept.

query_by_lang.description: The query in each language's own words, keyed by BCP-47 tag, e.g. {"zh": "人工智能 监管"} alongside query "AI regulation". Each language is searched with its own query (and searched even if not listed in lang). Translate the query yourself when researching several languages.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region, e.g. US or TW (Google News edition, Brave/Serper country).

since.description: Only results published since an ISO date (2026-09-01) or a span: 24h, 7d, 2w, 3m, 1y. Applied via provider date filters and page/feed dates; undated results are kept.

category.description: Metasearch engines to use: news (GDELT, Hacker News, Mastodon), general (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave and Google results pages, Wikipedia, Wikidata), science (arXiv, OpenAlex), it (Hacker News, GitHub, Stack Exchange), social (Mastodon). auto (default) = news when since <= 31 days or the query mentions news/latest/today, else general.

max_per_domain.description: At most this many sources per domain.

render.description: auto (default): render JS-heavy pages in a headless browser when plain HTTP returns no main text. off: plain HTTP only.

synthesis_config.description: Synthesis LLM provider config injected by the host. When all four fields are populated, takes precedence over the legacy DEEPSEEK_API_KEY/etc env-var path. Operators should not set this directly — the host populates it from the agent's configured provider.

api_key.description: Bearer token for the synthesis provider. Never logged.

model.description: Model id to request (e.g. deepseek-chat). Overridable via DEEP_SEARCH_SYNTHESIS_MODEL env.

provider.description: Provider label used by the v2 cost envelope (e.g. deepseek).
